strategies.name: Opening-range breakout
strategies.thesis: A close beyond the first 30 minutes' range, with volume and the indices agreeing, keeps going.

strategies.name: 52-week-high momentum
strategies.thesis: Stocks near their yearly high on heavy volume and above VWAP keep rising intraday.

strategies.name: VWAP pullback
strategies.thesis: On a trend day, a dip to VWAP that closes back in the trend is a low-risk continuation entry.
strategies.source: skill-algotrader (VWAP Pullback), VWAP breakout backtests on NIFTY

strategies.name: Gap-up fade
strategies.thesis: Large opening gap-ups overshoot and fade. Kept to test the claim: it lost 23% live in 5 days.
strategies.source: Ganesh S, 'I gave Claude ₹5000 to day trade'

strategies.name: RSI reversion
strategies.thesis: Intraday moves that stretch RSI to an extreme away from VWAP snap back. Breakouts lost in our first run.
strategies.source: quants.md O15 Intraday Bracket Reversion 5m and W07 Intraday RSI 15m (the only positive intraday entries)

strategies.name: Supertrend flip
strategies.thesis: When Supertrend flips direction on an intraday bar, the new trend carries on for the day.
strategies.source: Indian YouTube and blog staple (VWAP + Supertrend setups); ATR multiplier 3 is the common default

strategies.name: Previous-day high/low breakout
strategies.thesis: A close beyond yesterday's high or low marks a range expansion that keeps going.
strategies.source: Common Indian intraday setup; also the stop placement in the 'I gave AI ₹10 lakh' video's rules
